title: file_compressed: add a routine for a "quick-and-dirty" close.
description:
This is for use after we've gotten a write error; it doesn't bother
finish up any compression or writing anything out, and doesn't return an
error indication. It just frees up memory and closes the underlying file
descriptor for the file.

Use it in dumpcap.

notes.body: enabled automatic add to merge train when checks pass
